Depends on collecting items (several days); 30 min per addon to hand in

Quest for the {wiki:Mage Outfits|Mage Outfit} addons. Female characters get the Fluid Belt (vial lottery with {npc:Sandra}) and the Tiara (ingredients for {npc:Myra} in Port Hope). Male characters get the Wand (rescue {npc:Angelina} in the Dark Cathedral and deliver ingredients to {npc:Lynda}) and the Hat (deliver {item:Ferumbras' Hat} to {npc:Zoltan}). The quest also gives the achievement **Alumni** (male) or **Ritualist** (female).
Handing in the items in order
Angelina, next to the exit teleport
